chunks: Do not fight them unless they initiate the fighting, because, by the grace of Allāh, you are in the right and to leave them till they begin fighting will be another point from your side against them.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for initiating battle according to this ruling from the Battle of Siffin?
ai.summary: Delivered by Imam Ali (AS) to his troops before the Battle of Siffin, this directive emphasizes the principle of *hujjah* (legal justification) by ensuring Muslims remain in a state of defensive righteousness until the opposing forces break the truce. This strategic patience not only validates the military action in the eyes of God but also serves as a political and theological argument against the Umayyad forces, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on legitimacy through measured response rather than aggression.
